subject.why: The stack of fluffy pancakes with melting butter, amber syrup, blue plate, and fork stuck in the top is immediately recognizable and includes all briefed elements.

category.why: The composition strictly adheres to Category 2, featuring a solid flat surface and a smooth gradient wall in the same red color family without patterns or stripes.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermarks, frames, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The subject is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all sides and a bold, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: The palette is warm, saturated, and juicy, with the rich golden pancakes and cobalt plate standing out distinctly against the red background.

detail.why: The shapes are clean, bold, and free of busy textures, grooves, or distracting micro-details.

style.why: The 3D casual rendering perfectly matches the references with smooth volumes, soft lighting, satin sheen, and no harsh outlines.

bg_colour.why: background is red (100% of the background); planned red
